title: Riverfront Suite | Walk to Broadway & Stadium
description:
Stop fighting for rideshares and stay in the heart of the action. Our high-end corner unit offers the rarest luxury in Nashville: True Walkability. Watch the river flow from your private balcony, then stroll across the bridge to Nissan Stadium or walk into Germantown for a 5-star dinner.

The space
HIGHLIGHTS:
⬥ The View: Premier corner-unit positioning with panoramic views of the Cumberland River.
⬥ Walk to Everything: Cross the bridge to Nissan Stadium or walk to the Broadway Honky-Tonks.
⬥ Sleeps 8 Comfortably: A massive 3-bedroom layout designed for large groups and families.
⬥ Enclosed Garage: Includes access to a secure, private garage—a must-have for downtown.
⬥ The River King Suite: Private retreat with a King bed and a workspace overlooking the water.
⬥ Chef’s Kitchen: Open-concept social hub designed for pre-concert drinks and group meals.
⬥ Elevator Access: Seamless, stair-free entry to your luxury corner retreat.
⬥ The Vibe: Industrial-chic Nashville at its finest, located in the trendy North Capitol/Germantown area.

THE SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:
⬥ The River King Suite: King Bed, en-suite bath, and floor-to-ceiling river views.
⬥ The Queen Suite: Two plush Queen beds; perfect for groups of friends.
⬥ The Twin Suite: Two cozy twin beds at the quiet end of the hall.
⬥ Living Area: Designer lounge seating with plenty of room for the whole group.

UNBEATABLE ACCESS:
⬥ Nissan Stadium: 10-Min Walk (via the bridge)
⬥ Germantown Dining: 5-Min Walk (to Nashville’s best food scene)
⬥ Broadway Honky-Tonks: 15-Min Walk / 3-Min Rideshare
⬥ Sounds Stadium: 8-Min Walk

PROFESSIONAL HOSTING:
Managed by a dedicated team of Property Curators. We use organic cleaning supplies and provide 24/7 guest support.

Guest access
⬥ We utilize a digital lock with your own unique code that is emailed to you prior to check-in.
⬥ The entire space is yours. Please make yourself at home.

Other things to note
⬥ We use green & organic cleaning supplies
⬥ There is additional first-come first-serve parking in front of the building. 
⬥ The property is located near a train bridge, and trains may pass at various times during the day or night.  It’s perfect for those who want to be in the middle of the action, but light sleepers may prefer to use the provided earplugs.
